canon.summary: A soft-spoken combat medic who never raises her voice because her drones do the talking. Whisper fields a halo of palm-sized medical drones: they mend, they shield, and — when a walking tank needs humbling — they deliver a precisely aimed EMP dart. She is the cheapest contract on the season sheet and the first name good captains write down.

primarySources.note: Studio origin document: field-hospital service, self-built drone halo, the EMP dart improvised during the walker incident.
Kit design: support role, budget-priced roster glue, anti-tech utility dart, unaugmented-body fragility.

canon.selectedInterpretation: Season 0 baseline Whisper — a drone medic with one clever anti-tech trick, not a combat engineer.
assumptions: Her drones run on swappable cells; sustained output is limited by her own stamina directing them.

powerSources.name: drone_halo
powerSources.origin: Self-built ring of medical microdrones slaved to a neural band
interruptionConditions: arcane fields scramble the nanite-level machinery
she herself is an ordinary, unarmored human
drained power cells silence the whole halo until they trickle back

limitations.description: Negligible offense: the EMP dart stings machines, but she cannot meaningfully hurt anything herself.
An unaugmented body in a division of enhanced fighters — she survives by positioning and teammates.

weaknessSummary.description: Ordinary flesh and bone — kinetic trauma has nothing to overcome.
Arcane energies scramble her nanite machinery and bite her hard through the neural band.

behaviorSummary.combatIntelligence: Triage under fire — she tracks every teammate's vitals and is already moving before they call.
behaviorSummary.tacticalStyle: Hangs behind the line, keeps the drones cycling, spends the EMP dart on whatever machine is winning.
behaviorSummary.riskTolerance: Very low — a dead medic saves no one.
behaviorSummary.allyProtection: Absolute — she has carried people out of worse than this.
moralConstraints: Will not leave a wounded teammate
commandConstraints: Refuses disengage orders while an ally is critical

claims.selectedValue: sustained squad healing via drone halo and deployed stations
single-target EMP sting effective against tech-dependent fighters

aiAssumptions: Drone station output normalized to the engine's summon healing formula
mechanicalNormalizations: EMP dart kept at low power — its value is the tag interaction, not the damage

foundational.name: Triage Zap
foundational.description: A drone breaks formation to deliver a discouraging shock. It is a warning, not a weapon.

signature.name: Med-Drone
signature.description: She anchors a drone station over the fight — it hums quietly and keeps everyone near it breathing.

signature.name: Nano-Mend
signature.description: A stream of nanites closes wounds from the inside out — field surgery at the speed of flight.

signature.name: Shield Matrix
signature.description: Four drones weave a lattice of deflection film around whoever is about to be hit hardest.

signature.name: EMP Dart
signature.description: A needle of packaged lightning. It barely bruises flesh — but machines remember it for a long time.

escalation.name: Overclock Swarm
escalation.description: She overrides every safety and lets the halo hunt — a stinging cloud that harries the enemy until its cells burn out.

weaknesses.description: There is nothing enhanced about her body — kinetic trauma lands exactly as hard as physics says it should.
Arcane energies scramble her nanites and feed back through the neural band — magic hurts her twice.

behavior.personality: Soft-spoken, unhurried, impossible to rattle — the calm at the center of every emergency.

synergies.description: Tech-fighter telemetry gives her drones cleaner firing and mending solutions.

balance.priceRationale: Balanced profile. Scores — capability 47, versatility 52, reliability 60, counterability 54.

presentation.silhouette: Small figure in a field-medic coat beneath a slow halo of seven palm-sized drones
